//! # Individual Key Monitor
//!
//! This module provides low-level key monitoring for UI highlighting feedback.
//! It works alongside the global shortcuts system to detect when individual keys
//! are pressed/released, allowing the frontend to show proper visual feedback.

use std::collections::HashSet;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
use tauri::{AppHandle, Emitter, Manager};
use tokio::sync::Mutex as TokioMutex;
use tracing::{info, error, debug, warn};
use crate::state::AppState;

#[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
use core_graphics::event::{CGEvent, CGEventType, CGKeyCode, EventField};
#[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
use core_graphics::event_source::{CGEventSource, CGEventSourceStateID};

/// Key state tracking for visual feedback
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct KeyState {
    pub key_code: u32,
    pub key_name: String,
    pub pressed: bool,
    pub press_time: Option<Instant>,
}

/// Individual key monitor state
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct KeyMonitorState {
    pub active_keys: HashSet<u32>,
    pub monitored_shortcuts: Vec<MonitoredShortcut>,
    pub last_update: Instant,
}

/// Shortcut configuration for monitoring
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct MonitoredShortcut {
    pub name: String,
    pub shortcut_string: String,
    pub modifier_keys: Vec<u32>,
    pub main_key: u32,
    pub event_name: String,
}

impl KeyMonitorState {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            active_keys: HashSet::new(),
            monitored_shortcuts: Vec::new(),
            last_update: Instant::now(),
        }
    }

    pub fn update_active_key(&mut self, key_code: u32, pressed: bool) -> bool {
        let changed = if pressed {
            self.active_keys.insert(key_code)
        } else {
            self.active_keys.remove(&key_code)
        };
        
        if changed {
            self.last_update = Instant::now();
        }
        
        changed
    }

    pub fn check_shortcut_state(&self, shortcut: &MonitoredShortcut) -> ShortcutHighlightState {
        let mut pressed_keys = Vec::new();
        let mut has_main_key = false;
        let mut has_any_modifier = false;

        // Check main key
        if self.active_keys.contains(&shortcut.main_key) {
            has_main_key = true;
            pressed_keys.push(key_code_to_name(shortcut.main_key));
        }

        // Check modifier keys
        for &modifier in &shortcut.modifier_keys {
            if self.active_keys.contains(&modifier) {
                has_any_modifier = true;
                pressed_keys.push(key_code_to_name(modifier));
            }
        }

        ShortcutHighlightState {
            pressed_keys,
            has_main_key,
            has_any_modifier,
            is_complete: has_main_key && (shortcut.modifier_keys.is_empty() || has_any_modifier),
        }
    }
}

/// State of shortcut highlighting
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ShortcutHighlightState {
    pub pressed_keys: Vec<String>,
    pub has_main_key: bool,
    pub has_any_modifier: bool,
    pub is_complete: bool,
}

// Global state for the key monitor
static KEY_MONITOR_STATE: once_cell::sync::Lazy<Arc<TokioMutex<KeyMonitorState>>> =
    once_cell::sync::Lazy::new(|| Arc::new(TokioMutex::new(KeyMonitorState::new())));

/// Initialize the individual key monitoring system
pub async fn init_key_monitoring(app_handle: AppHandle) -> Result<(), String> {
    info!("[KeyMonitor] Initializing individual key monitoring system");

    // Load shortcuts from app state
    let app_state = app_handle.state::<AppState>();
    let shortcuts = app_state.keyboard_shortcuts.lock()
        .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to get keyboard shortcuts: {}", e))?
        .clone();

    // Configure monitored shortcuts
    let monitored_shortcuts = vec![
        MonitoredShortcut {
            name: "agent_mode_toggle".to_string(),
            shortcut_string: shortcuts.agent_mode_toggle.clone(),
            modifier_keys: parse_modifiers(&shortcuts.agent_mode_toggle),
            main_key: parse_main_key(&shortcuts.agent_mode_toggle),
            event_name: "key-highlight-agent-mode".to_string(),
        },
        MonitoredShortcut {
            name: "dictation_input".to_string(),
            shortcut_string: shortcuts.dictation_input.clone(),
            modifier_keys: parse_modifiers(&shortcuts.dictation_input),
            main_key: parse_main_key(&shortcuts.dictation_input),
            event_name: "key-highlight-dictation-input".to_string(),
        },
        MonitoredShortcut {
            name: "escape".to_string(),
            shortcut_string: "Escape".to_string(),
            modifier_keys: vec![],
            main_key: 53, // Escape key code on macOS
            event_name: "key-highlight-escape".to_string(),
        },
    ];

    {
        let mut state = KEY_MONITOR_STATE.lock().await;
        state.monitored_shortcuts = monitored_shortcuts;
    }

    // Start the monitoring task
    let app_handle_clone = app_handle.clone();
    tokio::spawn(async move {
        key_monitoring_task(app_handle_clone).await;
    });

    // Start platform-specific key monitoring
    #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
    {
        let app_handle_clone = app_handle.clone();
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            start_macos_key_monitoring(app_handle_clone).await;
        });
    }

    info!("[KeyMonitor] Individual key monitoring system initialized successfully");
    Ok(())
}

/// Main monitoring task that emits events for key state changes
async fn key_monitoring_task(app_handle: AppHandle) {
    let mut interval = tokio::time::interval(Duration::from_millis(16)); // ~60fps for smooth UI updates

    loop {
        interval.tick().await;

        let state = KEY_MONITOR_STATE.lock().await;
        
        // Check each monitored shortcut and emit highlight events
        for shortcut in &state.monitored_shortcuts {
            let highlight_state = state.check_shortcut_state(shortcut);
            
            if !highlight_state.pressed_keys.is_empty() {
                let event_data = serde_json::json!({
                    "shortcut_name": shortcut.name,
                    "pressed_keys": highlight_state.pressed_keys,
                    "has_main_key": highlight_state.has_main_key,
                    "has_any_modifier": highlight_state.has_any_modifier,
                    "is_complete": highlight_state.is_complete,
                    "timestamp": std::time::SystemTime::now()
                        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
                        .unwrap_or_default()
                        .as_millis()
                });

                if let Err(e) = app_handle.emit(&shortcut.event_name, event_data) {
                    error!("[KeyMonitor] Failed to emit highlight event {}: {}", shortcut.event_name, e);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

/// macOS-specific key monitoring using Core Graphics
#[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
async fn start_macos_key_monitoring(app_handle: AppHandle) {
    use core_graphics::event::{CGEventTap, CGEventTapLocation, CGEventTapPlacement, CGEventTapOptions};
    use std::ptr;

    info!("[KeyMonitor] Starting macOS key monitoring");

    // This is a placeholder for the actual macOS implementation
    // In a real implementation, you would set up a CGEventTap to monitor key events
    // For now, we'll use a simplified approach that checks key states periodically
    
    let mut interval = tokio::time::interval(Duration::from_millis(50));
    
    loop {
        interval.tick().await;
        
        // Check common modifier keys
        let option_pressed = is_key_pressed_macos(58); // Left Option
        let d_pressed = is_key_pressed_macos(2);       // D key
        let space_pressed = is_key_pressed_macos(49);  // Space
        let escape_pressed = is_key_pressed_macos(53); // Escape
        
        let mut state = KEY_MONITOR_STATE.lock().await;
        let mut any_changed = false;
        
        // Update key states
        if state.update_active_key(58, option_pressed) { any_changed = true; }
        if state.update_active_key(2, d_pressed) { any_changed = true; }
        if state.update_active_key(49, space_pressed) { any_changed = true; }
        if state.update_active_key(53, escape_pressed) { any_changed = true; }
        
        if any_changed {
            debug!("[KeyMonitor] Key state changed - Option: {}, D: {}, Space: {}, Escape: {}", 
                   option_pressed, d_pressed, space_pressed, escape_pressed);
        }
    }
}

/// Check if a specific key is currently pressed on macOS
#[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
fn is_key_pressed_macos(key_code: u32) -> bool {
    use core_graphics::event::{CGEventSource, CGEventSourceStateID};
    
    match CGEventSource::new(CGEventSourceStateID::HIDSystemState) {
        Ok(source) => {
            source.key_state(key_code as CGKeyCode).unwrap_or(false)
        }
        Err(_) => false,
    }
}

/// Parse modifier keys from shortcut string
fn parse_modifiers(shortcut: &str) -> Vec<u32> {
    let parts: Vec<&str> = shortcut.split('+').map(|s| s.trim()).collect();
    let mut modifiers = Vec::new();
    
    for part in &parts[..parts.len().saturating_sub(1)] {
        match part.to_lowercase().as_str() {
            "alt" | "option" | "opt" => modifiers.push(58), // Left Option on macOS
            "cmd" | "command" | "meta" => modifiers.push(55), // Left Command on macOS  
            "ctrl" | "control" => modifiers.push(59), // Left Control on macOS
            "shift" => modifiers.push(56), // Left Shift on macOS
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    
    modifiers
}

/// Parse main key from shortcut string
fn parse_main_key(shortcut: &str) -> u32 {
    let parts: Vec<&str> = shortcut.split('+').map(|s| s.trim()).collect();
    let key_part = parts.last().unwrap_or(&"").to_lowercase();
    
    match key_part.as_str() {
        "d" => 2,
        "space" => 49,
        "escape" | "esc" => 53,
        _ => 0, // Unknown key
    }
}

/// Convert key code to human-readable name
fn key_code_to_name(key_code: u32) -> String {
    match key_code {
        58 => "Option".to_string(),
        55 => "Cmd".to_string(),
        59 => "Ctrl".to_string(),
        56 => "Shift".to_string(),
        2 => "D".to_string(),
        49 => "Space".to_string(),
        53 => "Escape".to_string(),
        _ => format!("Key{}", key_code),
    }
}

/// Update the monitored shortcuts when keyboard shortcuts change
pub async fn update_monitored_shortcuts(app_handle: &AppHandle) -> Result<(), String> {
    let app_state = app_handle.state::<AppState>();
    let shortcuts = app_state.keyboard_shortcuts.lock()
        .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to get keyboard shortcuts: {}", e))?
        .clone();

    let new_shortcuts = vec![
        MonitoredShortcut {
            name: "agent_mode_toggle".to_string(),
            shortcut_string: shortcuts.agent_mode_toggle.clone(),
            modifier_keys: parse_modifiers(&shortcuts.agent_mode_toggle),
            main_key: parse_main_key(&shortcuts.agent_mode_toggle),
            event_name: "key-highlight-agent-mode".to_string(),
        },
        MonitoredShortcut {
            name: "dictation_input".to_string(),

            modifier_keys: vec![],
            main_key: 53,
            event_name: "key-highlight-escape".to_string(),
        },
    ];

    let mut state = KEY_MONITOR_STATE.lock().await;
    state.monitored_shortcuts = new_shortcuts;
    
    info!("[KeyMonitor] Updated monitored shortcuts");
    Ok(())
}

/// Force reset the key monitor state
pub async fn force_reset_key_monitor_state() {
    let mut state = KEY_MONITOR_STATE.lock().await;
    state.active_keys.clear();
    state.last_update = Instant::now();
    info!("[KeyMonitor] Key monitor state force reset completed");
}

/// Get current key monitor status for debugging

    let state = KEY_MONITOR_STATE.lock().await;
    serde_json::json!({

}

//! # Individual Key Monitor
//!
//! This module provides low-level key monitoring for UI highlighting feedback.
//! It works alongside the global shortcuts system to detect when individual keys
//! are pressed/released, allowing the frontend to show proper visual feedback.

use std::collections::HashSet;
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};
use tauri::{AppHandle, Emitter, Manager};
use tokio::sync::Mutex as TokioMutex;
use tracing::{info, error, debug, warn};
use crate::state::AppState;

#[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
use core_graphics::event_source::{CGEventSource, CGEventSourceStateID};
#[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
use core_graphics::event::CGKeyCode;

/// Key state tracking for visual feedback
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct KeyState {
    pub key_code: u32,
    pub key_name: String,
    pub pressed: bool,
    pub press_time: Option<Instant>,
}

/// Individual key monitor state
#[derive(Debug)]
pub struct KeyMonitorState {
    pub active_keys: HashSet<u32>,
    pub monitored_shortcuts: Vec<MonitoredShortcut>,
    pub last_update: Instant,
}

/// Shortcut configuration for monitoring
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct MonitoredShortcut {
    pub name: String,
    pub shortcut_string: String,
    pub modifier_keys: Vec<u32>,
    pub main_key: u32,
    pub event_name: String,
}

impl KeyMonitorState {
    pub fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            active_keys: HashSet::new(),
            monitored_shortcuts: Vec::new(),
            last_update: Instant::now(),
        }
    }

    pub fn update_active_key(&mut self, key_code: u32, pressed: bool) -> bool {
        let changed = if pressed {
            self.active_keys.insert(key_code)
        } else {
            self.active_keys.remove(&key_code)
        };
        
        if changed {
            self.last_update = Instant::now();
        }
        
        changed
    }

    pub fn check_shortcut_state(&self, shortcut: &MonitoredShortcut) -> ShortcutHighlightState {
        let mut pressed_keys = Vec::new();
        let mut has_main_key = false;
        let mut has_any_modifier = false;

        // Check main key
        if self.active_keys.contains(&shortcut.main_key) {
            has_main_key = true;
            pressed_keys.push(key_code_to_name(shortcut.main_key));
        }

        // Check modifier keys
        for &modifier in &shortcut.modifier_keys {
            if self.active_keys.contains(&modifier) {
                has_any_modifier = true;
                pressed_keys.push(key_code_to_name(modifier));
            }
        }

        ShortcutHighlightState {
            pressed_keys,
            has_main_key,
            has_any_modifier,
            is_complete: has_main_key && (shortcut.modifier_keys.is_empty() || has_any_modifier),
        }
    }
}

/// State of shortcut highlighting
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct ShortcutHighlightState {
    pub pressed_keys: Vec<String>,
    pub has_main_key: bool,
    pub has_any_modifier: bool,
    pub is_complete: bool,
}

// Global state for the key monitor
static KEY_MONITOR_STATE: once_cell::sync::Lazy<Arc<TokioMutex<KeyMonitorState>>> =
    once_cell::sync::Lazy::new(|| Arc::new(TokioMutex::new(KeyMonitorState::new())));

/// Initialize the individual key monitoring system
pub async fn init_key_monitoring(app_handle: AppHandle) -> Result<(), String> {
    info!("[KeyMonitor] Initializing individual key monitoring system");

    // Load shortcuts from app state
    let app_state = app_handle.state::<AppState>();
    let shortcuts = app_state.keyboard_shortcuts.lock()
        .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to get keyboard shortcuts: {}", e))?
        .clone();

    // Configure monitored shortcuts
    let monitored_shortcuts = vec![
        MonitoredShortcut {
            name: "agent_mode_toggle".to_string(),
            shortcut_string: shortcuts.agent_mode_toggle.clone(),
            modifier_keys: parse_modifiers(&shortcuts.agent_mode_toggle),
            main_key: parse_main_key(&shortcuts.agent_mode_toggle),
            event_name: "key-highlight-agent-mode".to_string(),
        },
        MonitoredShortcut {
            name: "dictation_input".to_string(),
            shortcut_string: shortcuts.dictation_input.clone(),
            modifier_keys: parse_modifiers(&shortcuts.dictation_input),
            main_key: parse_main_key(&shortcuts.dictation_input),
            event_name: "key-highlight-dictation-input".to_string(),
        },
        MonitoredShortcut {
            name: "escape".to_string(),
            shortcut_string: "Escape".to_string(),
            modifier_keys: vec![],
            main_key: 53, // Escape key code on macOS
            event_name: "key-highlight-escape".to_string(),
        },
    ];

    {
        let mut state = KEY_MONITOR_STATE.lock().await;
        state.monitored_shortcuts = monitored_shortcuts;
    }

    // Start the monitoring task
    let app_handle_clone = app_handle.clone();
    tokio::spawn(async move {
        key_monitoring_task(app_handle_clone).await;
    });

    // Start platform-specific key monitoring
    #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
    {
        let app_handle_clone = app_handle.clone();
        tokio::spawn(async move {
            start_macos_key_monitoring(app_handle_clone).await;
        });
    }

    #[cfg(not(target_os = "macos"))]
    {
        warn!("[KeyMonitor] Key monitoring not yet implemented for this platform");
    }

    info!("[KeyMonitor] Individual key monitoring system initialized successfully");
    Ok(())
}

/// Main monitoring task that emits events for key state changes
async fn key_monitoring_task(app_handle: AppHandle) {
    let mut interval = tokio::time::interval(Duration::from_millis(16)); // ~60fps for smooth UI updates

    loop {
        interval.tick().await;

        let state = KEY_MONITOR_STATE.lock().await;
        
        // Check each monitored shortcut and emit highlight events
        for shortcut in &state.monitored_shortcuts {
            let highlight_state = state.check_shortcut_state(shortcut);
            
            // Only emit events when keys are actually pressed
            if !highlight_state.pressed_keys.is_empty() {
                let event_data = serde_json::json!({
                    "shortcut_name": shortcut.name,
                    "pressed_keys": highlight_state.pressed_keys,
                    "has_main_key": highlight_state.has_main_key,
                    "has_any_modifier": highlight_state.has_any_modifier,
                    "is_complete": highlight_state.is_complete,
                    "timestamp": std::time::SystemTime::now()
                        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
                        .unwrap_or_default()
                        .as_millis()
                });

                if let Err(e) = app_handle.emit(&shortcut.event_name, event_data) {
                    error!("[KeyMonitor] Failed to emit highlight event {}: {}", shortcut.event_name, e);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

/// macOS-specific key monitoring using Core Graphics
#[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
async fn start_macos_key_monitoring(app_handle: AppHandle) {
    info!("[KeyMonitor] Starting macOS key monitoring");

    let mut interval = tokio::time::interval(Duration::from_millis(50)); // 20fps for key state checking
    
    loop {
        interval.tick().await;
        
        // Check common modifier keys and main keys
        let option_pressed = is_key_pressed_macos(58); // Left Option (Alt)
        let cmd_pressed = is_key_pressed_macos(55);    // Left Command
        let ctrl_pressed = is_key_pressed_macos(59);   // Left Control
        let shift_pressed = is_key_pressed_macos(56);  // Left Shift
        let d_pressed = is_key_pressed_macos(2);       // D key
        let space_pressed = is_key_pressed_macos(49);  // Space
        let escape_pressed = is_key_pressed_macos(53); // Escape
        
        let mut state = KEY_MONITOR_STATE.lock().await;
        let mut any_changed = false;
        
        // Update key states - only log changes to avoid spam
        if state.update_active_key(58, option_pressed) { any_changed = true; }
        if state.update_active_key(55, cmd_pressed) { any_changed = true; }
        if state.update_active_key(59, ctrl_pressed) { any_changed = true; }
        if state.update_active_key(56, shift_pressed) { any_changed = true; }
        if state.update_active_key(2, d_pressed) { any_changed = true; }
        if state.update_active_key(49, space_pressed) { any_changed = true; }
        if state.update_active_key(53, escape_pressed) { any_changed = true; }
        
        if any_changed {
            debug!("[KeyMonitor] Key state changed - Opt: {}, Cmd: {}, Ctrl: {}, Shift: {}, D: {}, Space: {}, Esc: {}", 
                   option_pressed, cmd_pressed, ctrl_pressed, shift_pressed, d_pressed, space_pressed, escape_pressed);
        }
    }
}

/// Check if a specific key is currently pressed on macOS
#[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
fn is_key_pressed_macos(key_code: u32) -> bool {
    match CGEventSource::new(CGEventSourceStateID::HIDSystemState) {
        Ok(source) => {
            source.key_state(key_code as CGKeyCode).unwrap_or(false)
        }
        Err(_) => false,
    }
}

/// Parse modifier keys from shortcut string
fn parse_modifiers(shortcut: &str) -> Vec<u32> {
    let parts: Vec<&str> = shortcut.split('+').map(|s| s.trim()).collect();
    let mut modifiers = Vec::new();
    
    for part in &parts[..parts.len().saturating_sub(1)] {
        match part.to_lowercase().as_str() {
            "alt" | "option" | "opt" => modifiers.push(58), // Left Option on macOS
            "cmd" | "command" | "meta" => modifiers.push(55), // Left Command on macOS  
            "ctrl" | "control" => modifiers.push(59), // Left Control on macOS
            "shift" => modifiers.push(56), // Left Shift on macOS
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    
    modifiers
}

/// Parse main key from shortcut string
fn parse_main_key(shortcut: &str) -> u32 {
    let parts: Vec<&str> = shortcut.split('+').map(|s| s.trim()).collect();
    let key_part = parts.last().unwrap_or(&"").to_lowercase();
    
    match key_part.as_str() {
        "d" => 2,
        "space" => 49,
        "escape" | "esc" => 53,
        "a" => 0, "s" => 1, "f" => 3, "g" => 5, "h" => 4, "j" => 38, "k" => 40, "l" => 37,
        "z" => 6, "x" => 7, "c" => 8, "v" => 9, "b" => 11, "n" => 45, "m" => 46,
        "q" => 12, "w" => 13, "e" => 14, "r" => 15, "t" => 17, "y" => 16, "u" => 32, "i" => 34, "o" => 31, "p" => 35,
        _ => 0, // Unknown key
    }
}

/// Convert key code to human-readable name
fn key_code_to_name(key_code: u32) -> String {
    match key_code {
        58 => "Option".to_string(),
        55 => "Cmd".to_string(),
        59 => "Ctrl".to_string(),
        56 => "Shift".to_string(),
        2 => "D".to_string(),
        49 => "Space".to_string(),
        53 => "Escape".to_string(),
        0 => "A".to_string(), 1 => "S".to_string(), 3 => "F".to_string(),
        _ => format!("Key{}", key_code),
    }
}

/// Update the monitored shortcuts when keyboard shortcuts change
pub async fn update_monitored_shortcuts(app_handle: &AppHandle) -> Result<(), String> {
    let app_state = app_handle.state::<AppState>();
    let shortcuts = app_state.keyboard_shortcuts.lock()
        .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to get keyboard shortcuts: {}", e))?
        .clone();

    let new_shortcuts = vec![
        MonitoredShortcut {

            main_key: parse_main_key(&shortcuts.agent_mode_toggle),

        MonitoredShortcut {

            modifier_keys: parse_modifiers(&shortcuts.dictation_input),
            main_key: parse_main_key(&shortcuts.dictation_input),
            event_name: "key-highlight-dictation-input".to_string(),
        },
        MonitoredShortcut {
            name: "escape".to_string(),
            shortcut_string: "Escape".to_string(),
            modifier_keys: vec![],
            main_key: 53,
            event_name: "key-highlight-escape".to_string(),
        },

    let mut state = KEY_MONITOR_STATE.lock().await;

pub async fn force_reset_key_monitor_state() {

## Summary

This solution provides:

1. **Individual Key Monitoring**: Detects when individual keys (Option, D, Space, Escape, etc.) are pressed/released
2. **UI Highlighting Events**: Emits events like `key-highlight-agent-mode` and `key-highlight-dictation-input` with detailed key state information
3. **Non-Intrusive**: Works alongside existing global shortcuts without interfering
4. **Platform-Specific**: Uses macOS Core Graphics APIs for accurate key state detection
5. **Performance Optimized**: Runs at 60fps for smooth UI updates, with 20fps key polling
6. **Robust**: Includes error handling, debugging commands, and graceful degradation

The frontend can now listen for events like:
- `key-highlight-agent-mode` - When Option+D keys are being pressed
- `key-highlight-dictation-input` - When Option+Space keys are being pressed  
- `key-highlight-escape` - When Escape key is being pressed

Each event includes:
- `pressed_keys`: Array of currently pressed key names
- `has_main_key`: Whether the main key (D, Space, etc.) is pressed
- `has_any_modifier`: Whether any modifier keys are pressed
- `is_complete`: Whether the complete shortcut combination is active

The frontend can use this information to provide real-time visual feedback showing which keys are currently held down, making the keyboard shortcuts much more discoverable and user-friendly.
